name: 13206 · Syracuse, NY
findings: ZIP 13206 (Syracuse) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13206 (Syracuse) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13206 (Syracuse) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
